summary.name: DomoAI
summary.one_liner: DomoAI is an AI video editor that turns text, images, or existing footage into animated or restyled video, with features like lip sync and style transfer.
use_cases: Restyling existing footage into anime or other art styles
Animating a still image with smooth motion
Making a talking avatar speak a script with lip sync
Transferring dance or action motion onto a photo character
Generating short AI videos from text prompts
Removing or replacing video backgrounds without a green screen
summary.what_it_does: The page describes DomoAI as an AI video platform that converts text, images, or footage into video. Listed features include restyling footage into anime or realistic styles, animating static images, creating talking avatars with lip sync, and transferring motion from reference videos onto characters. It also offers background removal ("Screen Keying" or "Subject only"), AI upscaling for resolution, and generation of frame-to-frame transitions from 2-8 uploaded images. The page says it integrates several third-party models (including Seedance, ByteDance and MiniMax models, and GPT Image 2 and Nano Banana for images) alongside its own DomoAI 2.5 model.
notable: Omni Reference blends image, video, and audio references into one consistent video
Integrates multiple third-party video and image models under one platform
Community gallery where users can remix viral creations with their own content
caveats: Free plan uses credits; paid subscriptions unlock more credits and advanced features, with details on a separate pricing page
Page does not state specific prices or credit limits
